Warm clay-brown walls with green verdigris copper accents. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. provenance.notes: Generated illustration of an invented bronze-age smelting hut; no real photograph, artwork, logo or lettering was used. The smooth all-clay dome with a glowing mouth keeps it apart from the white-walled, conical-roofed Granary and the flat-roofed Foundry Guild. The source image reached the project through a chat paste (a re-encode, not the owner's original file), so the recorded hash is of that pasted copy. Checked at zoom: no lettering. Generator provenance metadata (for example C2PA) is dropped by the re-encode. Non-commercial hobby game; re-check the terms before any commercial release (docs/asset-rights-ledger.md).
